content:
On June 5th, Marhelm put out our first of a two part interview with SFL CEO Ole Hjertaker. The market is taking notice. If you want to participate with a group of active investors chasing the best names, check out the Marhelm community. 

"Hjertaker thinks an upside in the dividends is most linked to the two rigs in the company. Hercules, their ultra deepwater rig, is in commercial discussions for 2024 at a moment when the market is at its tightest in almost a decade."
